blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld , an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.
blocks.zh: 虽然现有的相机可控视频生成模型可以产生可视化的有说服力的序列,但保持内在的4D相机相容性仍具有挑战性. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议建立一个“观察-国家-参考”框架,利用瞬间因果提示和重建前作,产生全球一致的、自由取景的4D场景。 在一个背景视频中,我们引入了Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Recent机制,在整个生成过程中强制实施多视角的上极限制和时间因果关系. 此外,我们开发了由重建驱动的几何反射管道,采用4D检索战略,以便能够对产生的产出进行动态自评和校正,提高一致性和准确性。 广泛的实验表明克罗诺世界在瞬间一致地,电影质地的4D场景生成中实现了最先进的性能,在各种情景中都有了强烈的概括和高真度几何.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Transforming sparse observations into freely navigable 4D worlds has long been a central goal of the field. Driven by recent advances in video generation and world models, modern generative architectures can synthesize cinematic-quality sequences and enable real-time interactive rendering. Beyond enabling cost-effective construction of immersive VR/AR environments [ 1 , 2 ] , these capabilities provide scalable, high-fidelity simulations that are critical for embodied intelligence [ 3 , 4 ] and autonomous driving [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 将稀有的观测转化为自由通航的4D世界长期以来一直是这个领域的核心目标. 在视频生成和世界模型的最新进步的推动下,现代基因结构可以合成电影质量序列并实现实时交互渲染. 除了能够以具有成本效益的方式构建浸润性VR/AR环境[1,2]外,这些能力还提供可伸缩的高真度模拟,对体现的智能[3,4]和自主驱动[5,6,7]至关重要.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, a “Tower of Babel” gap persists between 2D video generation and 4D scene reconstruction. While current video generation models [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] can produce visually plausible, pixel-level sequences, they struggle to maintain intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal consistency in the underlying scene representation. As a result, generated videos often violate multi-view geometric constraints, undermining both physical validity and temporal coherence.
Recent approaches [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] attempt to mitigate this issue by incorporating projected 3D representations (e.g., point clouds) as multi-view guidance within iterative render–generate–update pipelines. However, constructing 3D representations from coarse reconstructions of generated outputs introduces a critical failure mode: errors in synthesized frames are back-projected and fused into the 3D prior, creating a self-reinforcing feedback loop that amplifies inconsistencies and can ultimately lead to collapse in subsequent generations.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进步,2D视频生成和4D场景重建之间仍然存在“Tower of Babel”差距。 虽然目前的视频生成模型[8,9,10,11]可以产生可视的,像素级的序列,但是它们努力在基础场景表现上保持内在的4D相片一致性. 因此所生成的视频往往会违反多视图几何限制,破坏物理有效性和时间一致性.
最近的办法[12、13、14、15]试图通过将预测的三维表述(如点云)作为多视角指导纳入迭代渲染-生成-更新管道来缓解这一问题。 然而,从粗糙地重建生成的输出中构建出3D表达式,引入了一种关键的失败模式:被合成的帧出错被后推后并被熔入了3D前作,形成自强化的反馈回路,会放大不一致,最终会导致后世倒闭.

blocks.en: Fundamentally, these challenges can be attributed to three key limitations: 1) 4D Spatiotemporal Inconsistency: Current models generate videos that violate 3D epipolar geometry and 4D spatiotemporal constraints, preventing the formation of a consistent and persistent scene representation. 2) Error Accumulation and Exposure Bias: Due to training–inference discrepancies and inherited artifacts, errors at inference time accumulate over time, leading to pronounced dynamic distortions and spatial drift. 3) Spatial Forgetting and Geometric Degradation: Over temporal horizons and complex camera motions, existing methods fail to preserve global coherence and handle occlusions, resulting in “spatial forgetting” that can cause severe geometric degradation or collapse.
blocks.zh: 从根本上说,这些挑战可归结为三大限制因素: (1) 4D Spatiotepal 不一致:当前模型生成的视频会违反3D相位相位几何和4D相位相位限制,防止形成一致而持续的场景表现. (2) 误差累积和曝光比值: 由于训练-推论差异和所继承的文物,推论时间的错误随时间而累积,导致显著的动态扭曲和空间漂移. (3) 空间遗忘和几何降解: 在时间跨度和复杂的相机运动中,现有方法未能保持全球一致性并处理堵塞问题,导致“空间遗忘”可能导致几何严重退化或崩溃。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we draw inspiration from human cognition and propose an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework, ChronoWorld, for camera-conditioned, globally consistent 4D scene generation. The framework extracts spatiotemporal cues from external inputs ( observations ), compresses them into a structured latent space via geometric invariants ( state ), and refines predictions through geometry-aware feedback ( reflection ), yielding a persistent and unified representation.
At its core, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that leverages contextual views to preserve intra- and inter-frame dependencies, while enforcing multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality. We further propose a Spatial Context Augmentation strategy integrated with rectified flow, where perturbed memory cues encourage robustness and reduce error accumulation and exposure bias during spatial transformations. In addition, we augment the video diffusion model with a reconstructive multi-head decoder that maps latent features to 4D Gaussian attributes and motion fields, supported by auxiliary representation supervision to enhance spatiotemporal consistency.
To mitigate cumulative drift and address spatial forgetting and geometric degradation, we design a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline at inference time. Specifically, we build a unified 4D memory from feed-forward 4D Gaussians and global camera poses. An explicit 4D retrieval mechanism then evaluates generated outputs, filters inconsistent frames, and constructs a geometric consistency graph. Finally, we synchronize updates between the explicit memory and the implicit history cache to maintain accuracy and consistency over time.
The main contributions of our work are summarized as follows: • We propose ChronoWorld , an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework that bridges video generation and 4D reconstruction, enabling the synthesis of spatiotemporally consistent, free-view 4D scenes from input videos. • We introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that exploits spatiotemporal cues to enforce multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality during generation. • We develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving accuracy and consistency of the 4D representation. • Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high fidelity across diverse scenes and scales.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们从人类的认知中汲取了灵感,并提出了一个 " 观察-国家-参考 " 框架,即ChronoWorld,供摄像头、全球一致的4D场景生成。 该框架从外部输入(观测)中提取出spatiotemporal提示,通过几何变量(状态)将其压缩入结构化的潜在空间,并通过几何-知觉反馈(反射)来完善预测,产生持续而统一的代表性.
作为核心,我们引入了Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Recent机制,利用上下文的观点来维护框架内和框架间的依赖性,同时强制实施多视角的上极限制和时间因果关系. 我们进一步提出了空间环境增强战略,该战略与纠正流动相结合,其中扰动的内存提示鼓励稳健性,并减少空间转变过程中的误差积累和暴露偏差。 此外,我们用一个重建多头解码器来扩充视频传播模型,将潜在特征映射到4D高斯属性和运动场上,辅以表现监督,增强瞬间一致性.
为了减少累积漂移并解决空间遗忘和几何退化问题,我们在推断时设计了由重建驱动的几何反射管. 具体地说,我们从向前的4D高斯人和全局相机上构建出统一的4D内存. 然后一个明确的4D检索机制来评价生成的输出,过滤不一致的帧,并构建出几何一致性图. 最后,我们同步在显性内存和隐性历史缓存之间进行更新,以随着时间的推移保持准确性和一致性.
• 我们工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出ChronoWorld, 一个“观察-国家-参考”框架, 我们引入了Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Content机制,利用Spatiotemporal的提示,在一代人的时间里执行多视角的前极限制和时间因果关系。 我们开发了一个由重建驱动的几何反射管道,采用4D检索战略,以便能够对产生的产出进行动态自评和纠正,提高4D表述的准确性和一致性。 • 广泛的实验表明,ChronoWorld在瞬息万变、电影质量高的4D场景生成方面实现了最先进的性能,在各种场景和尺度上都得到了强烈的概括和高度的忠诚。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Camera-Controlled Video Generation. Recent progress in video generation has been driven by large-scale diffusion models [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] and autoregressive transformer architectures [ 20 , 21 ] . While these approaches achieve strong visual fidelity, conditioning on a single text or image input provides limited control over camera motion and restricts free-view exploration. Camera-conditioned methods [ 8 , 9 , 22 ] incorporate trajectory signals to guide video synthesis along prescribed camera paths. However, preserving geometric fidelity and scene consistency under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. Warping-and-repainting approaches project images into point clouds and warp them along trajectories, which improves spatial alignment but often introduces artifacts in unseen regions. Joint RGB-depth generation enables point cloud reconstruction for novel-view rendering, yet several limitations persist in 4D inconsistency.
blocks.zh: 相机控制器 影视世代. 视频生成的近期进展由大规模传播模式[16,17,18,19]和自相递变压器架构[20,21]所驱动. 虽然这些方法实现了强烈的视觉忠实,但以单一文本或图像输入为条件对相机运动的控制有限并限制了自由取景探索. 相机条件化方法 [8, 9, 22] 包含轨迹信号,以引导视频合成沿着规定的相机路径. 然而,在大范围观点变化中保持几何忠诚和场景一致性仍然具有挑战性。 Warping-and-repainting方法将图像投入点云并沿轨迹进行曲折,这改善了空间相通性,但往往在看不见的区域引进了文物. 联合RGB的深度生成可以使点云重建用于新视觉渲染,然而在4D不一致方面仍然存在一些局限性.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we integrate diffusion-based video generation with both implicit and explicit geometric priors. In addition, we introduce a spatiotemporal self-reflection mechanism that enables the model to preserve consistency throughout the generation process.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们把基于传播的视频制作与隐含和明确的几何前身结合起来。 此外,我们引入了spatiopal自反应机制,使模型能够在整个生成过程中保持一致性.

blocks.en: 3D and 4D Scene Generation. Existing 3D/4D generation methods can be broadly categorized into: (1) compositional scene generation [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , which assembles scenes from discrete 3D assets using layouts or scene graphs, and (2) end-to-end volumetric generation, which directly models scenes using representations such as occupancy fields, point clouds, voxels, or meshes. Compositional approaches improve object diversity and controllability but often struggle with realistic backgrounds and object–environment interactions. In contrast, end-to-end methods better preserve global semantic consistency, yet are constrained by limited 3D data, high annotation costs, and lower visual fidelity, and they do not fully benefit from large-scale 2D pretraining.
blocks.zh: 3D和4D场景生成. 现有的3D/4D生成方法可以大致分为: (1)组成场景生成 [23,24,25],利用布局或场景图将场景从离散的3D资产中组装出; (2)端到端的量子生成,直接用占用场,点子云,活塞等表示来模拟场景. 组成方法提高了物体的多样性和可控性,但往往与现实背景和物体与环境的相互作用相冲突。 相形之下,端到端方法更好地维护了全球语义的一致性,然而却受到有限的3D数据,高注成本和较低的视觉忠心度的限制,它们并没有完全受益于大规模的2D预训.

blocks.en: Our approach bridges this gap by integrating video generation with 4D reconstruction through spatiotemporal self-reflection and explicit 4D representation prediction, unifying generative modeling with geometric reasoning to produce spatially coherent 4D scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将视频生成与4D重建结合起来,通过瞬间自我反射和明确的4D表示预测,用几何推理统一基因模型,以产生空间上一致的4D场景,从而弥合这一差距。

blocks.en:
Generalizable Reconstruction. Traditional optimization-based approaches [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] rely on dense multi-view observations and per-scene optimization, which limits scalability. Feed-forward methods [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] incorporate geometric priors to handle sparse inputs, but they often fail to recover occluded or unseen regions.
Recent work combines generative models with reconstruction to improve multi-view consistency; however, performance remains dependent on accurate volumetric consistency, which are frequently violated in practice. In contrast, our method tightly couples controllable video generation with reconstruction-driven cue guidance, improving both geometric and semantic consistency and enabling photorealistic 4D reconstructive generation.
blocks.zh:
普遍重建. 传统的以优化为主的方法[26,27,28,29]依靠密集多景观测和人均景地优化,限制了可扩展性. 饲料前置方法[30,31,32]包含几何前置来处理稀有的投入,但它们往往无法恢复被占用或看不见的区域.
最近的工作将基因模型与重建结合起来,以提高多视图一致性;然而,性能仍然依赖于准确的音量一致性,而这在实践中经常被违反. 与此相反,我们的方法是用重建驱动的提示引导, 紧紧地制作夫妇可控视频, 改善几何和语义的一致性, 并促成光能现实化的4D重建生成。

blocks.en: This section presents ChronoWorld (Fig. 2 - 3 ), which unifies video generation and reconstruction via a hybrid training–inference paradigm under an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework. During training, spatiotemporal cues and a reconstructive multi-head decoder enforce geometric consistency in the latent space. During inference, a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection mechanism refines outputs and maintains a consistent 4D memory.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体结构

During training, we sample triplets of context videos, target videos, and target camera trajectories, where context and target sequences are temporally aligned but captured from different viewpoints. The causal 3D VAE encodes the inputs into latent representations Z c , Z t ∈ ℝ B × C × T × H × W Z_{c},Z_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times C\times T\times H\times W} , where B B , C C , T T , H H , and W W denote batch size, channels, timesteps, height, and width, respectively. We encode the camera trajectory { ( T i , R i ) } i = 0 T − 1 \{(T_{i},R_{i})\}_{i=0}^{T-1} into dense positional features using Plücker embeddings, followed by a two-layer MLP modulation network that injects the features into the attention keys K K and values V V .

blocks.en: 3.2 Diffusion Transformer with Spatiotemporal Cues
blocks.zh: 3.2 用 Spatiotemporal Cees 传播变形器

blocks.en: Existing diffusion models typically capture intra-frame spatial and inter-frame temporal dependencies via full-sequence cross- or causal attention, largely overlooking cross-frame spatiotemporal cues (i.e., latent correspondences along epipolar trajectories). This oversight introduces computational redundancy and degrades geometric consistency across overlapping regions.
blocks.zh: 现有的传播模型通常通过全序的交叉或因果注意来捕捉框架内空间和框架间的时间依赖性,基本上可以俯瞰跨框架的瞬间提示(即沿上层轨道的潜在对应)。 这种监督引入了计算冗余,并降低了重叠区域的几何一致性。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose a diffusion framework with Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention. By coupling multi-view geometric constraints with spatiotemporal augmentation, the model enforces coherent cross-view correspondence, enabling the generation of consistent 4D scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个传播框架,其中要注意到斯帕蒂奥特波尔-多极分层。 该模型通过将多视图几何限制与spatiotemporal增能相配合,强制进行相通的交叉视图通信,使相通的4D场景得以生成.

blocks.en: Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention. To reduce the computational redundancy and geometric ambiguity of unconstrained full-sequence attention, we propose spatiotemporal epipolar causal attention (ST-ECA). By integrating multi-view 3D priors with strict temporal causality, ST-ECA confines cross-frame interactions to geometrically valid, causally ordered regions.

blocks.en: 3.4 Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection
blocks.zh: 3.4 重建驱动的几何反射

blocks.en: A key limitation of existing video and 4D scene generation methods is that they lack reliable mechanisms to assess the quality of their own predictions, violating spatiotemporal consistency under zero-shot conditions. While recent 4D memory-augmented and post-reconstruction approaches attempt to enhance coherence, their uncorrected fusion of flawed predictions exacerbates error accumulation, inducing semantic drift, spatial forgetting, and geometric inconsistency.
blocks.zh: 现有视频和4D场景生成方法的一个关键限制是,它们缺乏评估自身预测质量的可靠机制,违反了零镜头条件下的瞬间一致性. 虽然最近的4D内存增强法和后重建法试图增强一致性,但其未修正的对有缺陷的预测的组合会加剧误差积累,诱发语义漂移,空间遗忘和几何不一致.

blocks.en: To address this, we propose an Observation-State-Reflection inference strategy with Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection. The framework performs iterative retrieval, selection, and self-refinement, breaking the accumulation of single-pass errors and establishing a feedback loop for correction. This enables robust, globally consistent 4D scene generation across time.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用以重建为动力的几何反射的观察-国家-参照推断战略。 框架进行迭代检索,选择和自修,打破了单行道出错的积累并建立了回馈回回路以进行校正. 这样就能够形成强有力的、全球一致的四维场景。

blocks.en: Unified 4D Memory Construction.
blocks.zh: 统一4D记忆建设.

blocks.en: While existing 3D-enhanced video generation methods passively unproject generated outputs into local spatial representations (e.g., depth maps, point clouds), their lack of global 4D modeling restricts them to static scenes and exacerbates error accumulation. blocks.en: Cycle Refinement via 4D Retrieval Selection. Given an observation 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , our STC-DiT and reconstructive multi-head decoder output complementary representations (RGB, Gaussian parameters, motions, and depth) to construct a Unified 4D Memory. To prevent flawed frames from corrupting generations via passive caching, we formulate this memory as a dynamically evaluated topological graph. At inference, we execute a cyclic refinement loop: the model self-assesses this graph, hard-prunes geometrically inconsistent nodes, and retrieves the top- K K reliable frames to dynamically refresh the KV cache. Conditioned on this curated context, corrupted regions are iteratively regenerated, thereby halting error propagation and reducing computational costs.

blocks.en: Active 4D Retrieval and KV Cache Refresh. Unlike conventional memory-augmented video generation that retrieves historical RGB frames or latent tokens based on appearance similarity, temporal proximity, or view overlap, our method retrieves structured 4D states in a unified Canonical Gaussian Space. Each state jointly represents persistent geometry, time-varying attributes, explicit motion, and depth. For the p p -th Gaussian primitive, its position at time t t is represented as 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) = 𝝁 ​ p + Δ ​ 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) \mathbf{x}{p}(t)=\boldsymbol{\mu}{p}+\Delta\mathbf{x}{p}(t) , where 𝝁 ​ p \boldsymbol{\mu}{p} is the canonical position and Δ ​ 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) \Delta\mathbf{x}{p}(t) is its temporal motion. Its time-varying attributes are similarly defined as 𝒜 ​ p ​ ( t ) = 𝒜 ​ p ⊕ Δ ​ 𝐚 ​ p ​ ( t ) \mathcal{A}{p}(t)=\mathcal{A}{p}\oplus\Delta\mathbf{a}{p}(t) . This formulation explicitly associates the same Gaussian primitive across time, turning historical observations into a queryable 4D memory rather than independent frame-level context.

blocks.en: The retrieval is performed recurrently throughout inference. Each generation step produces new RGB, Gaussian geometry, motion, and depth, which extend the Unified 4D Memory and are subsequently re-evaluated to update the consistency graph. The refined memory then undergoes hard pruning, Top- K K retrieval, and KV refresh for the next generation cycle, forming a closed-loop “generate → \rightarrow assess → \rightarrow prune → \rightarrow retrieve → \rightarrow refresh → \rightarrow regenerate” process. In this way, 4D RAG preserves scene information by actively recalling reliable states beyond the current temporal window, maintains a bounded inference context by restricting the active KV cache to K K retrieved states, and suppresses cumulative spatial and temporal drift by preventing inconsistent predictions from being repeatedly propagated through memory. This active, reliability-aware memory update is therefore essential for maintaining stable 4D reconstruction and generation over extended sequences.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. Our framework builds on Wan2.1 I2V [ 19 ] , augmented with a Diffusion Transformer with Spatiotemporal Cues (STC-DiT), Reconstructive Multi-Head Decoder (RMD), and camera pose embeddings with spatial context augmentation. We train on a mixture of public video generation and reconstruction datasets [ 38 , 44 ] , combining real and synthetic dynamic scenes. We perform rectified flow distillation for STC-DiT with learning rate 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , batch size 10, and 20K steps, using AdamW (weight decay 0.05) and a cosine schedule with linear warm-up. Subsequently, the RMD is trained incorporating geometric forcing, with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and a batch size of 10. DPM++ is used for efficient epipolar sampling. Training runs on 8 × \times A100 (80GB) GPUs, while inference uses a single A100 GPU. Additional details are provided in the Supplementary Material.

blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare our proposed ChronoWorld with state-of-the-art approaches in camera-controlled video generation, 3D-enhanced scene generation, and 4D dynamic scene generation.

blocks.en: Quantitative Comparison. As shown in Tab. 1 , our method consistently surpasses all baselines across all metrics, achieving stronger visual quality alongside significantly improved 4D consistency and trajectory accuracy. Among the baselines, camera-controlled video generation methods [ 38 , 8 , 9 , 47 ] generate visually plausible videos but suffer from shape drift and trajectory misalignment without 4D constraints and explicit reflection. Current 3D-enhanced scene generation methods [ 40 , 48 ] rely on static surfel- or point-based memory, struggling to synthesize high-fidelity, temporally coherent 4D dynamic scenes. Despite utilizing depth-warped conditioning, GEN3C [ 41 ] and TrajectoryCrafter [ 39 ] introduce pronounced textural artifacts stemming from unnatural geometric priors and flawed projections.
blocks.zh: 量比较. 如图一所示,我们的方法始终超越所有衡量标准的所有基线,实现了更高的视觉质量,同时大大提高了四维一致性和轨迹准确性。 在基线中,相机控制的视频生成方法[38、8、9、47]生成视似似视频,但发生外形漂移和轨迹错位而无4D限制和明显反射。 目前3D增强的场景生成方法[40,48]依赖于静态的表面-或点-的内存,难以合成出高精度,时间上一致的4D动态场景. GEN3C[41]和TrajectoryCrafter[39]尽管采用了深曲调,但引进了由非自然几何前身和有缺陷的预测而形成的显著地纹理文物。

blocks.en: While existing 4D dynamic scene generation methods [ 13 , 42 , 49 , 50 , 43 ] utilize 4D memory, their naive “generate-and-reconstruct” relies on expensive post-reconstruction and per-frame querying, inevitably amplifying error accumulation and inconsistencies. In contrast, our model achieves globally consistent conditional generation by aligning the implicit latent and 4D spaces via spatiotemporal constraints, and rectifying discrepancies through explicit geometric reflection.
blocks.zh: 虽然现有的4D动态场景生成方法[13,42,49,50,43]利用了4D内存,但其天真"基因再造"依赖于昂贵的后期再造和每帧查询,不可避免地会扩大出错积累和不一致. 相比之下,我们的模式通过瞬间限制来调整暗含的潜伏空间和4D空间,并通过明显的几何反射来纠正差异,从而实现全球一致的有条件生成。

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparisons on Spatiotemporal Consistency
blocks.zh: 4.3 空间一致性比较

blocks.en: In this work, we aim to enhance the spatiotemporal consistency of scene generation, jointly synthesizing cinematic-quality videos and geometrically coherent 4D representations. Thus, we validate the unified 4D memory by rendering target novel views and quantifying their photometric and spatiotemporal fidelity. Tab. 2 shows that our approach consistently outperforms our main competitors in preserving multi-view geometry and spatiotemporal consistency for 4D scenes. Notably, our Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention enforces latent geometric alignment, while Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection iteratively rectifies textural artifacts and spatial distortions.

blocks.en: Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention (ST-ECA) and Plücker ray embeddings jointly enforce multi-view geometric coherence and trajectory alignment. The introduced temporal tube masking, alongside spatial context augmentation, facilitates the mitigation of exposure bias and the rectification of spatial distortions. Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection proves effective in mitigating spatial forgetting and geometric degradation by enabling the generative model to iteratively rectify errors through self-reflection. Our proposed dual-stage training, coupled with geometry forcing, enables the model to decode 4D scene representations from latent features, thereby significantly enhancing the spatial consistency of predictions while accelerating the cyclic inference by 10 × \times .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we presented ChronoWorld, an “Observation-State-Reflection” framework for camera-controllable video generation that explicitly enforces 4D spatiotemporal coherence. By grounding the model in Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention, our approach incorporates multi-view geometric constraints and temporal reasoning directly into the generation. Combined with reconstruction-driven geometric reflection and an active 4D retrieval strategy, the framework enables dynamic self-assessment and correction, effectively mitigating error accumulation.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in synthesizing high-quality, free-view 4D scenes with strong geometric fidelity, temporal consistency, and trajectory accuracy.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了ChronoWorld,这是用于摄相机可控视频生成的“观测-状态-参考”框架,它明确执行4D分光谱一致性。 通过将模型建立在斯帕蒂奥特-多极分层分层注意(Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Content)中,我们的方法将多视角几何限制和时间推理直接纳入到一代中. 该框架与由重建驱动的几何反射和积极的4D检索战略相结合,能够进行动态自评和校正,并有效减轻出错积累.
广泛的实验证明ChronoWorld在合成高质量,自由取景的4D场景方面实现了最先进的性能,具有很强的几何忠诚度,时间一致性,和轨迹精度.
